headline: Thailand Seeks to Supply Auto and Electronics Parts to Japanese Satellites
summary: Thai Deputy Prime Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas initiated negotiations to integrate domestic precision components and electronics manufacturers into Japan's satellite supply chain.
why: Thailand is expanding its high-tech manufacturing base away from traditional internal combustion automotive parts toward advanced aerospace hardware.

impacts.name: Electronics Sector
impacts.why: Entry into Japanese space hardware supply chains opens industrial revenue opportunities.
